name: layoutfixer
title: LayoutFixer
description: Fix English and Persian text typed with the wrong keyboard layout, check spelling, and tidy up Persian text.
author: macan

commands.name: setup
commands.title: Setup and Shortcuts
commands.description: Check that everything is ready, set up hotkeys and try it out.

commands.name: fix-selection
commands.title: Fix Selected Text
commands.description: Retype the selected text in the right layout (English ⇄ Persian). With nothing selected, fixes the current line.

commands.name: undo-last-fix
commands.title: Undo Last Fix
commands.description: Undo the last fix and switch the keyboard layout back.

commands.name: fix-clipboard
commands.title: Fix Clipboard
commands.description: Fix the layout of the text on the clipboard.

commands.name: fix-spelling
commands.title: Check Spelling
commands.description: Find spelling mistakes in the selected English or Persian text and pick corrections.

commands.name: finglish-to-persian
commands.title: Finglish to Persian
commands.description: Convert Persian written in Latin letters (salam khobi) to Persian script.

commands.name: clean-up-persian
commands.title: Clean up Persian Text
commands.description: Fix half-spaces, punctuation, ی/ک and digits in the selected Persian text.

commands.name: persian-tools
commands.title: Persian Tools
commands.description: Numbers to Persian words, Jalali ⇄ Gregorian dates, Persian ⇄ Latin digits.

commands.name: ai-tools
commands.title: AI Writing Tools
commands.description: Fix, rewrite (formal or casual Persian), shorten or translate text with Raycast AI.

commands.name: convert-text
commands.title: Convert Text
commands.description: Type or paste text and preview every fix as you go.

commands.name: switch-layout
commands.title: Switch Keyboard Layout
commands.description: Toggle between your English and Persian keyboard layouts.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Keyboard Layout in Menu Bar
commands.description: Shows your current keyboard layout in the menu bar, with quick actions.

preferences.name: menuBarStyle
preferences.title: Show
preferences.description: What to show in the menu bar.

commands.name: fix-history
commands.title: Fix History
commands.description: Recent fixes, to copy or paste again. Turn it on in the extension settings.

commands.name: personal-dictionary
commands.title: Personal Dictionary
commands.description: Words that are never converted and never marked as misspelled.

preferences.name: persianLayout
preferences.title: Persian Layout
preferences.description: The Persian keyboard layout you type with. Automatic reads it from your Mac's input sources.

preferences.name: mode
preferences.title: Fix Mode
preferences.description: Smart only converts words that look mistyped, so names like github are left alone.

preferences.name: autoSelect
preferences.title: When Nothing Is Selected
preferences.description: Fix Selected Text can select the text before the cursor itself, so you don't have to.

preferences.name: fallbackToAll
preferences.title: Fixing
preferences.label: Convert the whole selection when no word looks wrong
preferences.description: Only for text you selected yourself.

preferences.name: switchLayout
preferences.label: Switch the keyboard layout after fixing
preferences.description: So the next words come out right.

preferences.name: capsLock
preferences.label: Fix text typed with Caps Lock on (hELLO → Hello)
preferences.description: Also reads SGHL as sghl when looking for Persian.

preferences.name: autoSpell
preferences.label: Correct obvious spelling mistakes in converted words
preferences.description: Only applies a correction when one is clearly the most likely.

preferences.name: persianDigits
preferences.label: Type digits as Persian (۱۲۳) when converting to Persian

preferences.name: cleanupAfterFix
preferences.label: Clean up Persian text after converting to Persian
preferences.description: Uses the Persian clean-up options below.

preferences.name: restoreClipboard
preferences.title: Behavior
preferences.label: Restore the clipboard after pasting
preferences.description: Pasting the fixed text goes through the clipboard; this puts back what was there.

preferences.name: showPreview
preferences.label: Show the fixed text in the HUD
preferences.description: Otherwise only says which language it was converted to.

preferences.name: history
preferences.label: Keep a history of fixes
preferences.description: The last 100 fixes, stored only on this Mac. Off by default.

preferences.name: englishSpeller
preferences.title: English Spell Checker
preferences.description: Persian spelling always uses LayoutFixer's built-in Persian word list.

preferences.name: cleanupHalfSpace
preferences.title: Persian Clean-up
preferences.label: Half-spaces: می‌خواهم, کتاب‌ها, بزرگ‌تر
preferences.description: Joins می / نمی, ها / های and تر / ترین with a half-space.

preferences.name: cleanupPunctuation
preferences.label: Persian punctuation: ، ؛ ؟ «»
preferences.description: Next to Persian words only. Also removes the space before punctuation.

preferences.name: cleanupDigits
preferences.label: Persian digits in Persian sentences
preferences.description: URLs and English words keep their digits.

preferences.name: cleanupSpaces
preferences.label: Extra spaces and kashida (ـ)
preferences.description: Collapses repeated spaces and removes stretched letters.

preferences.name: ignoredWords
preferences.title: Ignored Words
preferences.description: Comma-separated words that are never converted or marked as misspelled, on top of the Personal Dictionary.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
